draft.subject: Embedded Software Engineer I/II — M.S. CE, STM32/FreeRTOS Background
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, a recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology. I wanted to reach out about the Embedded Software Engineer I/II opening at Zone 5 — my background in real-time firmware, multi-sensor integration, and hardware debugging maps directly to what the role requires.

Two projects most relevant to Zone 5's work: I built an STM32-based object-tracking turret running FreeRTOS, communicating with an NVIDIA Jetson over UART for real-time control commands, with multi-servo PWM, interrupt-driven command parsing, and VL53L0X ToF ranging over I2C. In a bare-metal firmware project, I programmed STM32 peripherals directly in C — GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, and I2C1 — achieving a 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM footprint at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate, verified in Proteus. Both projects were debugged with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

On the systems side, I have fabricated single-layer PCBs in EAGLE, read schematics for sensor integration, and resolved 11 hardware integration failures on a physical robotic system — the kind of hands-on bring-up and troubleshooting work that shows up in UAS flight test environments. Zone 5's focus on autonomous systems for complex real-world missions is exactly the application space I want to work in.

I have attached my resume and would welcome a conversation about the role.
